display.purpose: Hero headlines and major titles; Redaction serif.

label.purpose: Nav, footer, eyebrows, metadata; Atkinson Mono with tracking.

shadows.name: media-inset
shadows.purpose: Work grid media cells and prose images at rest.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default quiet button for errors and secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); background: #241c14; color: #c9b89a; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { color: #ffc933; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); background-color: #2a2118; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb900; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Site Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation link in mono (chrome link pattern).
components.css: .ds-nav { font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-nav__link { color: #fffbeb; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__link:hover { color: #ffc933; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #ffc933; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav__link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb900; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Prose Link
components.description: Inline link in long-form reading: body color with amber border-bottom.
components.css: .ds-prose { font-family: "Instrument Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.68; color: #fffbeb; max-width: 43rem; } .ds-prose a { color: #fffbeb; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #ffb900; } .ds-prose a:hover { color: #ffc933; border-bottom-color: #ffc933; } .ds-prose a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb900; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Home Hero CTA
components.description: Underline CTA on homepage hero, not a filled button.
components.css: .ds-hero-cta { display: inline-block; border-bottom: 4px solid #ffb900; padding-bottom: 0.25rem; font-family: "Redaction", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.2; color: #fffbeb; text-decoration: none; } .ds-hero-cta:hover { color: #ffc933; border-bottom-color: #ffc933; } .ds-hero-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb900; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Work Grid Tile
components.description: Homepage showcase cell with tonal hover.
components.css: .ds-work-tile { display: block; padding: 1rem; background-color: #2a2118; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); text-decoration: none; color: #fffbeb; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-work-tile:hover { background-color: #16110d; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); } .ds-work-tile__label { font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #c9b89a; } .ds-work-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb900; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Editorial Blockquote
components.description: Serif pull quote with amber left rule.
components.css: .ds-blockquote { margin: 0; padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.35rem); border-left: 2px solid #ffb900; border-radius: 0.25rem; background-color: #2a2118; color: #fffbeb; font-family: "Redaction", Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2vw, 1.55rem); line-height: 1.4; }

narrative.overview: A hiring-facing portfolio where long-form craft is the interface. Serif display and mono metadata frame Instrument Sans body type on a warm brown-black canvas; amber accent appears sparingly but decisively. Surfaces stay mostly flat; depth comes from tonal steps and hairline rules.
keyCharacteristics: Three locked type roles: Redaction, Instrument Sans, Atkinson Mono
Warm canvas with amber accent as punctuation
Hairline borders define chrome and tiles

rules.name: The Amber Punctuation Rule
rules.body: Accent color appears on roughly 10% of any screen. If amber fills large backgrounds, the palette has gone loud.

rules.name: The Three-Role Lock Rule
rules.body: Redaction for display, Instrument Sans for body, Atkinson Mono for metadata and chrome.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Prefer raising a surface one token step or strengthening a border before adding box-shadow.

dos: Do use CSS custom properties from themes/theme.css for every color.
Do apply amber accent to section numbers, pull-quote marks, and hover links.
Do use Instrument Sans for body and Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for metadata.
Do use semantic HTML and focus-visible outlines.
donts: Don't use SaaS landing patterns: hero metrics, identical feature card grids, gradient text, modal-first flows.
Don't ship generic AI portfolio tropes: Inter/Roboto, purple gradients, decorative glass, side-stripe accent borders.
Don't treat the site like a Dribbble shot without case-study depth.
Don't borrow corporate marketing visuals: stock heroes, buzzword headlines, logo walls.
Don't hardcode hex in component CSS or use pure #000 / #fff neutrals.
Don't change frozen homepage headline or showcase grid layout during visual experiments.
Don't introduce Tailwind, Bootstrap, or other CSS frameworks.
